samples.question: Four panels read top to bottom. Every panel shows the same five slot columns and a shaded vertical band (the region) that always covers the middle column. Four tokens - one red, one green, one blue, one orange - sit in the slots, with exactly one token per occupied slot, and each token keeps its fixed color as it may move between panels. A token is inside the region when it is in the middle shaded column. Reading the panels top to bottom, which token is the FIRST to move from outside the region into the region? Answer 'red', 'green', 'blue', or 'orange'.
